The Secretary

To, 
            
 
 
 
The Secretary 
Listing Department 
National Stock Exchange of India Limited 
Exchange Plaza, Bandra Kurla Complex  
Mumbai – 400 051 
 
Scrip Code- NH 
 
Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio Recording of Earnings Call for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026  
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 
2015 (“SEBI Listing Regulations”) and further to our letters dated October 26, 2026 and October 30, 
2026, we wish to inform you that the Earnings Call of the Company for the quarter and half year ended 
September 30, 2026 was held today, November 02, 2026 (Monday) and the Audio Recording w.r.t. the 
Earnings Call has been uploaded and is available on the website of the Company at 
https://www.narayanahealth.org/stakeholder-relations/earnings-call-audio-and-transcripts. 
 
Further, in the call, the management answered the queries related to the financial results and operations 
for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. This is for your information and records. 
 
Thanking you 
 
Yours faithfully 
For Narayana Hrudayalaya Limited 
 
 
 
 
Sridhar S. 
Group Company Secretary, Legal & Compliance Officer 
SESHIAH 
SRIDHAR
